reports.title: Black Hills Corp. Reports 2026 Third-Quarter Results and Reaffirms 2026 Earnings Guidance

lines: Reaffirms 2026 adjusted earnings guidance in the range of $4.25 to $4.45 per share, excluding merger-related costs

We expect earnings to begin mid-2027 and increase to approximately $150 million of net income in 2030, consisting of returns on investment of $1.8 billion in 564 MW of new generation, and microgrid management fees based on contracted customer load.

“Given strong execution by our team in serving our customers and advancing our regulatory and growth initiatives, we expect to deliver in the upper half of our 4% to 6% long-term EPS growth target supported by our current plan for 2026 to 2030.
Black Hills reaffirms its guidance for 2026 adjusted EPS* to be in the range of $4.25 to $4.45, based on the following assumptions:
